name: Golden West Telecommunications
old_description: Golden West Telecommunications has been connecting South Dakota people and communities since 1916.
about:
Golden West Telecommunications, a member-owned cooperative, has been headquartered in Wall, South Dakota since its founding in 1916. It began as the first company to stretch telephone lines across the remote plains of western South Dakota.

The cooperative provides fiber-optic internet, voice telephone, and cable television services to residential and business customers across the state. Its business division offers co-managed IT services, unified communications, and dedicated internet and phone solutions. The network spans from the western border to the eastern edge of South Dakota.

Golden West serves households, farms, and enterprises throughout South Dakota. Its customer base includes family-run hospitality operations such as hunting lodges and agricultural producers like beekeepers, alongside small businesses and rural communities.

Organized as a cooperative, Golden West returns surplus earnings to members as capital credits and gives members a voice in governance. The company emphasizes community giving through scholarships, economic development awards, and donations, aiming to keep South Dakota life rewarding.
